meta.name: problem-framing-canvas
meta.description: Guide teams through MITRE's Problem Framing Canvas. Use when you need a clearer problem statement before jumping to solutions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导团队用画布理清问题定义
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队常因问题定义不清而走错方向
copy.tagline_en: Guide teams to clarify problem statements using a structured canvas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team often goes in the wrong direction due to unclear problem definition

howto.what: Claude 会引导你通过 MITRE 问题框架画布的三个阶段（向内看、向外看、重新定义），提出结构化问题，最终生成清晰的问题陈述和“How Might We”问题。
howto.when: 当你描述一个模糊的问题或需求，并希望先理清问题再寻找解决方案时触发。

say.text: 帮我用问题框架画布分析移动端留存问题。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成三个阶段的提问。

say.text: 我们团队对用户流失有不同看法，用画布帮我们对齐。
say.note: Claude 会从向内看阶段开始，询问你的假设。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through the MITRE Problem Framing Canvas in three phases (Look Inward, Look Outward, Reframe), asking structured questions to produce a clear problem statement and a 'How Might We' question.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a vague problem or request and want to clarify it before jumping to solutions.

say_en.text: Run a Problem Framing Canvas for our mobile retention issue.
say_en.note: Claude will walk you through the three phases.

say_en.text: Help me reframe this stakeholder request before we build anything.
say_en.note: Claude starts with the Look Inward phase.
